decision: Checkout writes each order once, under an idempotency key, and answers immediately
why: Synchronous chains fail as a whole; a customer should never see an error caused by a partner.
alternative: Checkout calls carriers, tax and payment in sequence.
value: API latency 450 → ~200 ms on the real system this is modeled on.

decision: One canonical order event, versioned and contract-tested, that every other part listens to
why: Systems may disagree on screens, never on what an order is.
value: New consumers need no change to checkout.

decision: One adapter per carrier with its own circuit breaker; failures park and replay after a dry run
why: A slow partner must not exhaust shared capacity, and recovery should be a reviewed action.

decision: The v0.1 React Flow page is rebuilt on the story engine: one focus per step, plain and engineering layers
why: The old page had 7 px labels, twelve packets at once and no way back a step.
value: 16 px plain text, keyboard steps, pause and reduced motion, at a fraction of the JS.

decision: Only the four measured before/after metrics appear, and they are labeled as measured on the real systems
why: Everything else on these pages is synthetic; mixing the two would cost trust.
value: Honest numbers next to a fictitious design.
